source_contract.dispatcher: Each requested20/21 independently: direct->16->15->14->12->7 after current-pointer checks; unaligned A/B use public Dense fallback; no20/21 mutual or19 fallback.

source_contract.run_contract: Current binding guards re-evaluated on every run; launch transforms fresh A/B in that call. Zero matrix/workspace allocation, no host synchronization, one warp CTA and zero shared launch. Setup/tune behavior belongs outside steady-state run.

static_compilation.load_packing: Six PRMT selector0x5410 pack unchanged B11/B21/B22 pairs; B12 is only a DAG source and its intermediate packed-word formation can be optimized away. Compiler interleaves some current-stage loads/conversions with early HMMAs, so source NativeOperands does not prove all42 operand words simultaneously remain live.
static_compilation.resource_comparison: Same measured binary identity15 and prefetch19 report REG96/SHARED6400/LOCAL0/STACK0. Direct20 reports REG128, direct21 REG120, both SHARED0/LOCAL0/STACK0. Register increase is observed; occupancy or latency mechanism is not established.
static_compilation.instruction_count_limit: All opcode totals are static disassembly counts, including control flow, prologue/conditional paths and unreachable padding; they are not dynamic issue counts. Exact24 direct20/21 and prefetch16/19 have7 static HMMA each; owner16x16 cpasync17 has14. No conclusion of halved total work follows from7 versus14.
static_compilation.actual_barrier_limit: No direct shared/LDSM/barrier/shuffle/local-memory instructions found. Samebinary15/19 likewise emit no standalone BAR/WARPSYNC/MEMBAR, so this is not evidence that standalone barrier instructions were removed.
static_compilation.attribution_limit: Direct20 relative identity15 changes .CONSTANT vector input loads to ordinary scalar loads, load granularity, address/packing work, register lifetimes and shared operations. Direct21 relative prefetch19 additionally changes lookahead; no gain or loss is attributed exclusively to shared removal.
static_compilation.aggregate_work_limit: M8 uses every physical16x8 MMA lane/C slot but emits only top8x8. Compared with M16 over equal logical output area, CTA count, native MMA and logical B work approximately double while A work approximately matches. Zero shared and fewer words per owner do not mean reduced full-problem work or measured DRAM bytes.
